user.title: EnergyOS sensor setup
user.description: Select instantaneous power sensors (W/kW), not cumulative energy counters (kWh). Use PV total or individual PV systems, and signed grid power or both import/export channels.

data.pv: Single PV total power (alternative; do not select together with both PVs)
data.grid: Signed grid power (alternative: positive import, negative export)
data.load: Optional independently measured house load (do not use estimates)
data.pv_roof: PV system 1 · Roof KOSTAL instantaneous power (W/kW)
data.pv_carport: PV system 2 · Carport Anker instantaneous power (W/kW)
data.grid_import: Smart meter · Grid import power (W/kW; NOT kWh)
data.grid_export: Smart meter · Grid export power (W/kW; NOT kWh)

error.same_source: A sensor cannot be mapped to multiple roles
error.pv_required: Select at least one PV source
error.pv_conflict: Select either PV total OR individually mapped PV systems
error.grid_required: Select signed grid power OR both separate import and export power
error.grid_conflict: Do not mix signed grid power with separate import/export channels
